title: Reject impossible receipt dates before ranking the specimen queue
prompt:
Fix calendar validation in lib/ohworks-priority-escalation.ts. Lines 218-220 and 236-240 accept timestamps whenever Date.parse returns a finite value. JavaScript rolls February 30 into March. I reproduced a routine specimen received at 2026-02-30T12:00:00Z remaining routine with elapsedMinutes=10 at currentAt=2026-03-02T12:10:00Z, using escalation thresholds 60 and 120 minutes. This bypasses the existing invalid-receipt stat outcome. The demo queue consumes this evaluator at lib/ohworks-demo-tat-priority-view.ts:63.

Add local validation of literal ISO calendar and clock fields before parsing both currentAt and receivedAt. Reject impossible month/day combinations, including non-leap February 29. Preserve valid Z and explicit-offset timestamps. Invalid current timestamps must throw the existing current-timestamp-invalid error; invalid receipt timestamps must retain the existing stat, receipt-timestamp-invalid, null-elapsed outcome and queue ordering. Leave priority policies and sorting semantics unchanged.

Add tests/ohworks/priority-receipt-calendar.test.ts with the reproduction, impossible current timestamps, April 31, valid leap-day and offset controls, and a mixed queue proving invalid receipts remain conservatively ranked. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/priority-escalation.test.ts tests/ohworks/priority-receipt-calendar.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-tat-priority-view.test.ts.

Planning verification reproduced the defect and passed the existing evaluator and demo-view tests. Edit only the named evaluator and new test; no shared utility or consumer changes. Use synthetic data; no credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, auth, package.json, or workflow changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
